items.docs: Returns relevant information regarding Neoload Web resources and version.

params.name: fromDateTime
params.description:
Date-time with an offset of the beginning of the search. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Example 2020-01-01T09:00:00+00:00

params.name: toDateTime
params.description:
Date-time with an offset of the end of the search. Format YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ
Example 2020-01-01T09:00:00+00:00

params.name: groups
params.description: The types of the usage data you expect to get. It will return all the types if the field is left empty. (Ctrl+click to select multiple values)

params.name: subGroups
params.description: The sub types of the usage data you expect to get. It will return all the types if the field is left empty. (Ctrl+click to select multiple values)

params.name: limit
params.description: The maximum number of elements returned by this call.

params.name: offset
params.description: The offset of the first element to return. Starting at this offset, the query will return a maximum of 'limit' elements.

params.name: format
params.description: The format of the Usage data.

items.docs:
Returns relevant usage.

This endpoint may produce large files. For production purposes please prefer using an API client rather than the browser.
